title: Dumb
body: To expensive compare to things you can get for free, just use Google Maps and have a set point to drive to without going there, it will show you all streets and intersections.

title: CarPlay
body: I must say I love this app, especially with a CarPlay integration. However I have noticed in some areas, the GPS cannot properly acquire the street I am on. It seems to do very well on community roads, but oddly when I get on to larger roads it seems to know my cross streets but cannot detect the street I am on. Overall it is a great app and has resulted in me removing my Garmin for cross streets.

title: CarPlay Support
body: I would absolutely give it 5 stars, but I wish it had better support for Apple CarPlay. I mean it works, but the map shows up very small on the screen while the letters are humongous. It would be great to make it more proportionate or just develop a more user-friendly interface that will display easily on CarPlay

title: Highly Recommended
body: Based on my experience utilizing this application within the justification I work in. Often times I was met with a burden of being in an area I wasn’t knowledgeable of. If it wasn’t for running this application, I wouldn’t have known exactly where I was in the heat of the moment. I highly recommend any LE Officer to adapt to running this app 24/7 since you’ll never know exactly when your in dire need of knowing the exact 100 block or direction of flight to relay to corresponding agencies or co workers. With utilizing the live location, Officers can intercept your moving location if back up is needed WITHOUT asking where you’re at. That tool alone could potentially save a life. Once again I highly recommend this application to any LE Officer in this line of work.

title: App
body: Patrol nav is amazing I use it every shift it has never failed me.

title: Super super useful!
body: Amazing for traffic stops! Our pursuit policy is terrible but I can see this being helpful during a pursuit, quick glance and you know where you are including a block range. Developer is very responsive on Discord too. Overall, totally worth it! Any tool that’ll increase safety is important to me, this hits the nail on the head.

title: Excellent App, but needs a few improvements.
body: As a LEO, this app is definitely very useful, but I’d like some additions or improvements. Not all intersections or cross streets show up as “nearest intersection”. It would be better if it just shows every nearest street that joins the one you’re on. There are a lot of side streets that don’t show up as intersections and it would be helpful for more accurate reporting. Trying to cancel navigation to an address is difficult, buttons are small, and trying to do a lot of things on the GPS while driving is a bit difficult especially when you’re trying to get somewhere quickly. The address numbers on the map are perfect and very much needed, but would be amazing if it would show the nearest address when stopped for easy access unless on a major street, especially if there’s no nearest cross streets. Add the ability to have the info panel switch from top to bottom on CarPlay. The display in a lot of cruisers is a bit cut off due to differing heights of individuals and I cannot see the panel a bit due to my height, and I don’t necessarily want to move the edges of the GPS when I can just have the panel on the bottom instead of top. probably got more suggestions as I use it but so far so good. The panel to input addresses and such definitely needs a QOL update.

title: Work app
body: Definitely comes in clutch for pursuits great app overall. Very accurate for the most part and I love that it includes block numbers

title: Amazing Tool for Patrol officers
body: Absolutely amazing. Makes nav and radio call outs 10x easier. Great Developer who interacts with his customers

title: Excellent for directions
body: I’ve been using the app for a couple weeks now, and have had nothing but good things to say about it. The developer has been nothing but helpful with questions about the app, and takes all suggestions seriously and updates the app frequently.
